title: Write to a Run/RunOnce autostart key
reason: reg.exe (PID 7524) was started with arguments that write an autostart value under CurrentVersion\Run — Windows runs such a value at every sign-in.
counterfactual: Would not fire for a registry read or delete (`reg query`, `reg delete`), or for a write to a key Windows does not execute at sign-in.

title: Write to a Run/RunOnce autostart key
reason: The application created or changed the autostart value "argusdemo" under \registry\user\s-1-5-21-3269454356-704034853-1866064328-1001\software\microsoft\windows\currentversion\run — Windows runs this value at every sign-in.
counterfactual: Would not fire if the value were written under a key Windows does not execute at sign-in (for example the installer's own product key or the Explorer settings), or if the key were only read.

title: Interpreter with encoded or remote payload
reason: powershell.exe (PID 2756) was started with the argument pattern "-EncodedCommand", which is used to run hidden or remotely supplied code.
counterfactual: Would not fire for an ordinary invocation without encoded, URL or script-host arguments.

title: Executable payload dropped in a writable location
reason: The application created .exe payload "argus-demo.exe" in a user-writable directory (c:\users\kamal\appdata\local\temp).
counterfactual: Would not fire for a download or installer writing to a user-selected folder only if the extension were not executable, and would not fire for a payload that was only opened (create disposition OPEN_EXISTING) rather than dropped.

title: Executable launched from a user-writable directory
reason: argus-demo.exe (PID 5932) was launched from a temporary directory: "C:\Users\kamal\AppData\Local\Temp\argus-demo.exe", a directory any program running as the user can write to.
counterfactual: Would not fire if the image were started from its installed directory (Program Files, System32 or the user's own program folder). Updaters, portable applications and installers that stage a helper in a temporary directory legitimately do this, which is why the severity is low and the finding is about the location only.
